title: A long trail day by day
description: The daily legs are tied to water, campsites and the supplies you carry.

blocks.text: When preparing several days, a person wants to tie their own legs to water and campsites. One overall line does not answer how such a plan is put together.

quote.text: It’s complicated and hard to figure out. I’ll explore YouTube a bit but I just want to create our own trip with way points, camp sites and water locations on the AT?  Why didn’t that easy to do?  Just want a long weekend hike and can’t seem to figure out how to build my own.

blocks.text: Edit a leg together with its points

Split the chosen path by day and add campsites and the water points that have been marked. When the boundary of a day moves, show which points and distances went across to the neighboring leg. Keep the date of the original note alongside.
Test whether a separate tool is needed

First find out what people plan their days with now and what they have to carry between the map and their notes. If a single good list of legs inside an existing map does the job, a new service can only make preparation harder.
